extracted.intended_audience: governments, development practitioners, donors, civil society, researchers, and the general public interested in the World Bank's mission and impact
extracted.subtask_description: An institutional 'Who We Are' / About page summarizing the World Bank Group's mission, guiding principles for development programming, organizational mandates of its five institutions, impact scorecard metrics, and accountability/data initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet
rubrics_metrics.description: Our mission is to end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is threatened by multiple, intertwined crises. Time is of the essence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Playbook principle — Inclusive of everyone
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusive of everyone, including women and young people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of a new playbook to drive impactful development; inclusion explicitly highlights gender and youth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Playbook principle — Resilient to shocks
rubrics_metrics.description: Resilient to shocks, including against climate and biodiversity crises, pandemics and fragility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resilience is framed broadly to cover environmental, health, and fragility-related shocks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Playbook principle — Sustainable
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustainable, through growth and job creation, human development, fiscal and debt management, food security and access to clean air, water, and affordable energy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustainability links economic growth, human development, fiscal/debt management, and basic services including food and clean energy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated World Bank Group client engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: To achieve this, we will work with all clients as one World Bank Group, in close partnership with other multilateral institutions, the private sector, and civil society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes a unified, multi-stakeholder approach when engaging clients and delivering development programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: IBRD mandate
rubrics_metrics.description: IBRD — International Bank for Reconstruction and Development: Provides financial products and policy advice to help middle-income and creditworthy low-income countries reduce poverty and respond to regional and global challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IBRD's focus/eligibility centers on middle-income and creditworthy low-income countries and combines financing with policy advice.

rubrics_metrics.name: IDA mandate
rubrics_metrics.description: IDA — International Development Association: Offers grants and low-interest loans help low-income countries invest in their futures, improve lives, and create safer, more prosperous communities around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IDA targets low-income countries and provides concessional financing (grants and low-interest loans) for development investments.

rubrics_metrics.name: IFC mandate
rubrics_metrics.description: IFC — International Finance Corporation: Advances economic development and improves the lives of people by encouraging the growth of the private sector in developing countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IFC focuses on private-sector development as the engine for economic development and livelihood improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: MIGA mandate
rubrics_metrics.description: MIGA — Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency: Provides political risk insurance (guarantees) for projects in a broad range of sectors in developing member countries, covering all regions of the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MIGA's product is political risk insurance/guarantees to support investment in developing member countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICSID mandate
rubrics_metrics.description: ICSID — International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes: The world’s leading institution devoted to international investment dispute settlement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ICSID's role is dispute settlement for international investment disputes; not a financing arm but a legal/institutional mechanism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact metric — Protection for the poorest (social safety nets)
rubrics_metrics.description: 221.8 million people directly benefited from social safety net operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a Scorecard metric (link provided); illustrates a measurable outcome for social protection interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact metric — Resilience to climate risks
rubrics_metrics.description: 123.2 million people supported with enhanced resilience to climate risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scorecard metric capturing number of people reached with programs to enhance climate resilience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact metric — Connected communities (infrastructure)
rubrics_metrics.description: 142.4 million people benefited from improved access to transportation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scorecard metric reflecting infrastructure outcomes, specifically improved transport access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accountability and transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Trust is crucial to our work. We strive to be open, transparent, and participatory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accountability mechanisms referenced include the Scorecard, Inspection Panel, Compliance Advisory Ombudsman, and Accountability Mechanism as institutional avenues for oversight and recourse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnerships for people and the planet
rubrics_metrics.description: The world's challenges are increasingly complex. Solving them requires strong global partnerships with governments, communities, NGOs, and businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions partnerships across public, private, and civil society as a core criterion for effective development action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data initiatives to inform and empower
rubrics_metrics.description: Our data initiatives inform and empower citizens, researchers, and changemakers around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights openness and use of data as a tool for accountability, research, and civic engagement (link to 'Explore the Data').
